subject: Re: Request for temporary capacity padding for real-time inference POC
messages:
From: Sara Lim <sara@bluefield.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tim O'Neill <tim@bluefield.ai>, procurement@bluefield.ai
Date: 2028-05-15T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Capacity ask for next week's real-time throughput sweep

Hi Camila —

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. We're excited to run the real-time inference sweep next Wednesday (5/22). Our engineering lead wants to validate sustained 2k qps with 30ms p50 on short prompts. Based on our initial runs in the sandbox, we'll need a short-term increase in credits/capacity to run the full end-to-end soak and compare latency numbers across regions.

Request: an additional 120k token-equivalent credits valid for a 72-hour window (starting 5/22 00:00 UTC) and the option to temporarily pin a lower-latency model variant for the run. We can provide the test plan and a signed MAUP if required.

Let me know what you need from procurement to accelerate approvals — Tim is copied.

Best,
Sara Lim
Performance Engineering Lead
BlueField Analytics

Attachment: poc-test-plan.pdf (PDF, 240KB)
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lim <sara@bluefield.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-05-15T18:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity ask for next week's real-time throughput sweep

Sara —

Appreciate the details and the test plan, looks solid. Quick answers up front: we can provision a temporary credit pool for a 72-hour soak and pin a model variant for the duration. A few operational notes and ask-list so we can move this same-day: 

- Exact start/end UTC window you want (you mentioned 5/22 00:00 UTC; confirm end at 5/25 00:00 UTC).
- Confirm the token-equivalent metric you're using (is the 120k referring to input tokens or total token budget?).
- For the pinned model, we need an explicit model tag (we can pin redwood/gemini-small-v2-qa-lite or redwood/latency-optimized-1) — let us know preferred latency vs quality tradeoff.
- Procurement: if you can route a signed MAUP to procurement@redwood.ai and confirm the billing contact, we can fast-track the credit authorization.

Jonas — can you approve the 120k token-equivalent promotional credit and set the duration to 72 hours once BlueField confirms? Marissa — can you stand by to create the temporary route and set model pin once the window is locked?

If everyone agrees, I'll queue the credit issuance and send an implementation checklist.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0193

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-05-16T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity ask for next week's real-time throughput sweep

Camila / Marissa —

Approve the 120k promotional credit for BlueField for the 72-hour window, pending the MAUP and the confirmed UTC window. Please note the credit will be scoped to the BlueField POC project (deal BD-4729) and expire automatically at the end of the window.

Operational constraints: the model pin will be applied to the POC project route only; if BlueField tries to hit another model we will route to a fallback. Marissa, please coordinate with infra to ensure the pin is sticky and that KV-cache warmup is triggered 30 minutes before the start.

Jonas
VP, Sales Engineering
jonas@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lim <sara@bluefield.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-05-17T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity ask for next week's real-time throughput sweep

Sara / Team —

All set on our end. Confirmed start: 2028-05-22T00:00:00Z, end: 2028-05-25T00:00:00Z. We've issued a temporary credit pool: 120000 tokens (tagged BD-4729-POC) and attached the MAUP for signature (docusign-maup.pdf). The pin to redwood/latency-optimized-1 will be applied to the POC route; infra will kick off warmup 30 minutes prior as requested.

Next steps for BlueField:
- Sara / Tim: sign the MAUP via the DocuSign link in the attachment and reply with the confirmation.
- Procurement: please confirm billing contact and PO number if needed.

If anything changes, ping me on Slack (@marissa) and we'll pause the run. Good luck with the sweep — eager to see the numbers.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

Attachments: docusign-maup.pdf (DocuSign envelope), infra-checklist.txt (referenced)
